note: What is known about each model from its card and its licence, separate from what this project measured. A row here is a claim with a source; a figure in results/ is a measurement with a host. Keeping them apart is what stops a vendor's number being read as ours. Shape is fixed by model-catalogue.schema.json. Rows are keyed by Hugging Face repository id, which is what a run manifest carries as `modelId` - three runs of one model at two voices and two quantisations share one row here. A field nobody has a source for is written `null` on purpose: the page prints `not recorded` for a null and would print nothing at all for a missing key, and those are different facts.

onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX.name: Kokoro-82M
onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX.architectureNote: StyleTTS2 + ISTFTNet. One pass produces the whole utterance, so nothing is sequential across the audio.
onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX.arenaNote: TTS Arena V2, read 2026-09-12. Highest-rated model on the board flagged open.

onnx-community/KittenTTS-Nano-v0.8-ONNX.name: KittenTTS nano 0.8
onnx-community/KittenTTS-Nano-v0.8-ONNX.architectureNote: StyleTTS2 + ISTFTNet + mini-ALBERT - the same family as the incumbent, at a fifth the size.
onnx-community/KittenTTS-Nano-v0.8-ONNX.arenaNote: Not in TTS Arena V2. Won a blind listening test against the compact field at 71.2 percent.
onnx-community/KittenTTS-Nano-v0.8-ONNX.warning: Do not use the int8 build - upstream reports open issues, and an independent port measured altered durations. The fp32 build will not load under kokoro-js either: the repository ships kitten_config.json and voices.npz but no tokenizer.json, which kokoro-js fetches unconditionally. Verified 2026-09-13.

onnx-community/KittenTTS-Mini-v0.8-ONNX.name: KittenTTS mini 0.8
onnx-community/KittenTTS-Mini-v0.8-ONNX.architectureNote: StyleTTS2 + ISTFTNet + mini-ALBERT, the larger of the two KittenTTS builds.
onnx-community/KittenTTS-Mini-v0.8-ONNX.warning: Blocked for the same reason as the nano build: no tokenizer.json in the repository, so kokoro-js cannot load it. Verified 2026-09-13.

onnx-community/chatterbox-multilingual-O.name: Chatterbox multilingual
onnx-community/chatterbox-multilingual-O.architectureNote: Llama backbone plus S3Gen flow decoder. One forward pass per audio frame, which is what makes an autoregressive model slow on a processor with no graphics card.
onnx-community/chatterbox-multilingual-O.arenaNote: TTS Arena V2, read 2026-09-12. Ranks ABOVE the incumbent, and the licence is more permissive.
onnx-community/chatterbox-multilingual-O.warning: Watermarking is off for a measurement and would have to be on for anything published.

onnx-community/Supertonic-TTS-ONNX.name: Supertonic TTS
onnx-community/Supertonic-TTS-ONNX.warning: The voices carry no accent labels, so an accent here can only be judged by ear and must never be printed as a fact about the model. The upstream source repository is archived.

Xenova/mms-tts-eng.name: MMS-TTS English
Xenova/mms-tts-eng.architectureNote: VITS. It needs no speaker embedding, which is what makes it the control arm: if this one fails, the harness is the problem and not the model.
Xenova/mms-tts-eng.warning: Non-commercial licence, so it could never ship. It is on the page as a control, not as a candidate.

owensong/Inflect-Micro-v2-ONNX.name: Inflect-Micro-v2
owensong/Inflect-Micro-v2-ONNX.arenaNote: Not in TTS Arena V2. Highest UTMOS22 of the compact set in its own published benchmark, which is the author's measurement rather than ours.

onnx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base.name: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B
onnx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base.architectureNote: Several ONNX graphs - text embedding, talker, audio encoder, waveform decoder - driven by a generation loop, so it needs its own runner rather than a one-call adapter.
onnx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base.warning: Runtime not wired. The most plausible autoregressive candidate on size alone: against the runner's measured 23.7 GB a second, 1.5 GB of weights is roughly 16 backbone steps a second against a 12.5 Hz frame rate.

onnx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base.name: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B
onnx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base.architectureNote: The larger sibling of the 0.6B build, on the same multi-graph generation loop.

onnx-community/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b.name: Higgs Audio v3 TTS
onnx-community/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b.architectureNote: Multi-graph, on the same generation loop as the Qwen3 builds.
onnx-community/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b.warning: Runtime not wired, AND the licence is non-commercial, so it could never ship. The repository totals 57 GB because it carries six variants; the processor-only 4-bit one is 3.59 GB.
